test_title: PYST 09: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 09 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: LQRU is related to ONTS in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, RKVQ is related to UHXO. To which of the given options is XEZM related, following the same logic?
solution:
Here is the alphabetical place value for each letter:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/685f6baa432537e202617dfc889eb0fd97507adab9f4133aa448db9312a0fed2.png] 

The logic followed in this pattern is a series of alphabetical shifts for each letter position: **+3, -3, +2, -2**.

**For 'LQRU' related to 'ONTS'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e5b506038e27c156e3d5fd903c2cc56f72eae1949e5800d54f0e08401e5ef5b.png] 

**For 'RKVQ' related to 'UHXO':**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a4038b6c97ca806b39f6410a25092443fd50cb0444e55f1f102e8d5184c50fea.png] 

The consistent pattern observed is **+3, -3, +2, -2**.

**Applying the same logic to 'XEZM':**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0cf27160d981a3f33577efa44e4044342704c87b63e71c7038aa9c19e7882114.png] 

Thus, XEZM is related to ABBK.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
